summary: Introduces aborting a play on all hosts: `any_errors_fatal` stops after the first failure, and `max_fail_percentage` aborts after a given percentage of hosts fail.
questions: How do I stop the whole play if one host fails?
Can I abort if too many hosts fail?

answer_card.title: Abort a play on all hosts
answer_card.answer_md: Use `any_errors_fatal` to stop the play on all hosts after the first failure, or `max_fail_percentage` for finer control, aborting once a given percentage of hosts has failed.
